_comment: Multi-chain collator monitor. Nodes are identified by libp2p PeerID (recommended, stable across restarts), by exact telemetry display name, or by SS58 address (any prefix — Kusama- and Polkadot-style both work; address monitoring checks Session.Validators / CollatorSelection.Candidates / Invulnerables on-chain). Chains are resolved by label against the live telemetry registry (unique substring works too).
_alertComment: Set TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN and TELEGRAM_CHAT_ID as GitHub Actions secrets to enable Telegram alerts.
